name: Pressure
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of pressure and adversity in the believer's life, as seen in Psalms 118:5 where the LORD delivers from distress and John 16:33 which reminds us that tribulation is part of the world but Christ has overcome it. Proverbs 24:10 encourages strength and perseverance during difficult times, while Romans 8:28 assures that God works all things together for good for those who love Him. Transformation through the renewing of the mind, as taught in Romans 12:2, equips believers to discern and follow God's perfect will amid pressures, including challenges like peer pressure and physical pressures such as blood pressure.
